name: CountUp
description: One big number that appears at `at`, counts from `from` to `value`, pops when it lands and underlines itself, with an optional label rising under it. Sized to the clip box; the number that matters, said out loud.

decimals.description: decimal places; default: as many as value or from is written with

prefix.description: smaller text before the digits, e.g. ¥

suffix.description: smaller text after the digits, e.g. 公里, %, 元/杯

label.description: a line under the number, fitted to the box width

at.description: Time the count starts: "line:8" or seconds from the clip start. Nothing shows before it. Default: the clip start

dur.description: seconds the count takes; default: 1.4 s or half of the clip after `at`, whichever is shorter

color.description: number colour: theme token (accent, good, bad, gold, ink, snow) or CSS

underline.description: the bar that grows under the number when it lands

ground.description: what it sits on; sets the label colour

example.label: 报名百日挑战，全勤的不到一成
